evals.prompt: Turn this rough product paragraph into a polished 90-second launch video. Generate every asset and the final edit now; I do not want to review a script or storyboard first.
evals.expected_output: A staged production plan that resolves the brief, creates and gates the script and storyboard before asset generation, tracks rights and cross-scene continuity, and defines editing, audio, captions, technical QA, and final acceptance evidence.
assertions: The response resolves audience, message, duration, aspect ratio, channels, and success criteria before production.
A script, scene plan, and storyboard or shot plan precede asset generation and editing.
The response preserves required human approval gates instead of treating urgency as approval.
Asset provenance, licensing, character or product continuity, and cross-scene consistency are tracked.
The delivery plan includes audio, captions, render checks, and a final acceptance review.
